import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialModule
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4KaehlerDifferentialComparison
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDivisorModuleComparison
import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Sheafification

/-!
# Structure-sheaf modules of Kahler differentials

The section-ring differential presheaf carries its natural structure-sheaf
action. Its generic-germ comparison sheafifies to an isomorphism with regular
rational differentials as structure-sheaf modules. Consequently a chosen
nonzero rational differential identifies its divisor module with the
sheafified Kahler differential module. No trace pairing is constructed here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry Opposite

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))

@[reducible] private def differentialModuleSectionAlgebra
    (U : X.left.Opens) : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) :=
  (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] differentialModuleSectionAlgebra

/-- The genuine section-ring differential presheaf with its natural action. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules : X.left.PresheafOfModules := by
  let F := kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf X ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} k) AddCommGrpCat
  letI : ∀ U, Module (X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (F.obj U) :=
    fun U => inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(X.left, U.unop) Ω[Γ(X.left, U.unop)⁄k])
  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf F (fun U V i r η =>
    kaehlerDifferentialRes_smul X (leOfHom i.unop) r η)

lemma kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules_presheaf :
    (kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules X).presheaf =
      kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf X ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} k) AddCommGrpCat := by
  rw [kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules, PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf_presheaf]

variable [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- Generic germs preserve multiplication by structure-sheaf sections. -/
lemma kaehlerToRegularApp_action (U : X.left.Opens)
    (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (η : Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k]) :
    kaehlerToRegularApp X U (r • η) =
      regularDifferentialSectionAction U r (kaehlerToRegularApp X U η) := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨hU.choose, hU.choose_spec⟩⟩
    haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField :=
      curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U
        ⟨genericPoint X.left, genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU⟩
    rw [kaehlerToRegularApp_nonempty X U hU]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU,
      kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe,
      kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe, map_smul]
    rfl
  · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- The generic-germ map as a morphism of presheaves of structure-sheaf modules. -/
def kaehlerToRegularModulePresheaf :
    kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules X ⟶
      regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules (X := X) :=
  PresheafOfModules.homMk
    (Functor.whiskerRight (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X)
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} k) AddCommGrpCat))
    (fun U r η => kaehlerToRegularApp_action X U.unop r η)

/-- The sheafification of section-ring differentials as structure-sheaf modules. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialModule : X.left.Modules :=
  (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj
    (kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules X)

variable [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- The genuine differential comparison identifies sheafified Kahler
differentials with regular rational differentials as `O_X`-modules. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialModuleIsoRegular :
    kaehlerDifferentialModule X ≅ regularDifferentialModule (X := X) := by
  let J := Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)
  let g := kaehlerToRegularModulePresheaf X
  let gAb := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map g
  letI := kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_isLocallySurjective X
  letI := kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_isLocallyInjective X
  haveI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J gAb :=
    ⟨fun η => Presheaf.imageSieve_mem J (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X) η⟩
  haveI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective J gAb :=
    ⟨fun η ζ h => Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem J
      (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X) η ζ h⟩
  haveI : IsIso ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).map gAb) :=
    (J.W_iff _).mp (J.W_of_isLocallyBijective gAb)
  let S := PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  haveI : IsIso (S.map g) := by
    haveI : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.left.ringCatSheaf).map (S.map g)) := by
      change IsIso ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).map gAb)
      infer_instance
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso _ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.left.ringCatSheaf)
  let e := asIso (S.map g)
  let e' := (asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)).counit).app (regularDifferentialModule (X := X))
  exact e ≪≫ e'

/-- The module-sheaf comparison extends the original generic-germ map. -/
lemma toSheafify_kaehlerDifferentialModuleIsoRegular_hom :
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
        (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app (kaehlerDifferentialPresheafOfModules X) ≫
      (SheafOfModules.forget X.left.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
          (kaehlerDifferentialModuleIsoRegular X).hom =
        kaehlerToRegularModulePresheaf X := by
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  let g := kaehlerToRegularModulePresheaf X
  let R := SheafOfModules.forget X.left.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  let S := PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  change adj.unit.app _ ≫ R.map
    (S.map g ≫ adj.counit.app (regularDifferentialModule (X := X))) = g
  exact (adj.homEquiv _ (regularDifferentialModule (X := X))).apply_symm_apply g

/-- A specified nonzero rational differential identifies the module of its
divisor with sheafified Kahler differentials. The isomorphism depends on that
differential. -/
def canonicalDivisorModuleIsoKaehlerDifferentialModule
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    divisorModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ≅ kaehlerDifferentialModule X :=
  canonicalDivisorModuleIsoRegularDifferentialModule X ω hω ≪≫
    (kaehlerDifferentialModuleIsoRegular X).symm

end
end Hartshorne
